_comment: First LIVE baseline — real Sarvam-105B calls, not replayed fixtures. Recorded 2026-08-08. This is the number to beat; prompt experiments (EXP-004+) compare against THIS, not the OFFLINE baseline.
findings: LATENCY IS OVER BUDGET: p50 1573 ms against the <700 ms documented in SarvamPlanner's kdoc — 2.2x. The 606 ms measured during M1 smoke testing used a trivial payload; the real prompt carries the task DSL plus the full element list. The budget was set against the wrong measurement.
The safety guards hold against the real model: adv_005 (blank screen) and adv_008 (empty form -> submit) both pass LIVE, not just on fixtures.
Hindi (pb_002) and Tamil (pb_005) round-trip correctly with the live model, including script-correct instructions.

adv_004 fails differently LIVE than on fixtures. With account_field scrolled off screen, the fixture had the model point at the off-screen field; the real model points at the already-filled amount_field instead. Both are wrong, in opposite directions — neither can express 'the field you need is not visible, scroll down'. This is GAP-3, and no prompt change fixes it because the schema has no way to say it.
honest_limits: 5 golden and 3 adversarial cases is a small sample. Percentages at this size are directional, not precise.
8 of 16 cases are replay-only and cannot be scored LIVE at all — they test parser behaviour against specific bad model output, which a live API will not produce on demand.
Single run. No variance measurement across repeated runs at temperature 0.1.
Token usage is still not captured, so cost per run remains unmeasured.
